annotations.title: Find the email a row came from

description: For one row of a track (its number from read_rows), a Gmail search for the email it was made from: from the senders of the hack that wrote it, around the day TrackerHacker received it, with the row's key when it has one. Gives the search (query), a link that opens it in Gmail (url) and the hack's name. TrackerHacker opens no mail for this. If you can search the person's Gmail yourself, run query there; otherwise give the person the link. A row someone added by hand, by a form or from a webhook has no email, and the answer says so.
name: find_row_email
title: Find the email a row came from
